text:
Some friendships are written beyond the surface… deep within the ocean’s soul. 
Made with Seedance 2.0 on @yapper_so 
 Prompt:

🎬 HOLLYWOOD FANTASY MOVIE OPENING PROMPT

(Boy Riding a Magical Fish Through the Ocean | Cinematic Adventure Opening | 15s)

“Ultra-cinematic Hollywood fantasy movie opening set in a breathtaking magical ocean world. A young boy rides on the back of a giant beautiful mystical fish swimming through crystal-clear deep blue water. The fish is elegant, glowing softly with iridescent scales, long flowing fins, and majestic eyes. The atmosphere feels magical, emotional, adventurous, and visually stunning like a high-budget fantasy film opening.

The underwater world is alive with glowing corals, ancient ruins, colorful sea creatures, sun rays piercing through the water, bubbles, and cinematic ocean depth. The fish lovingly takes the boy on a journey through the ocean, showing him the homes of different sea animals.

The boy feels amazed, peaceful, and deeply connected to the magical fish, gently petting its back while smiling with pure joy.

---

⏱️ 0:00 – 0:03 | MAGICAL INTRO

Wide cinematic shot of the endless ocean under golden sunlight.

Giant mystical fish rises gracefully from deep water

Young boy sitting safely on its back

Water sparkles around them

Massive whales swimming in the distance

🎥 Camera: cinematic aerial shot diving smoothly underwater
🎵 Sound: emotional orchestral fantasy music begins

---

⏱️ 0:03 – 0:06 | UNDERWATER JOURNEY

The magical fish swims deeper into the glowing ocean world.

Boy touches the fish gently, smiling in wonder

Schools of colorful fish surround them

Giant sea turtles glide beside them

Dolphins jump playfully nearby

🎥 Camera: smooth cinematic tracking shots + underwater slow motion

---

⏱️ 0:06 – 0:09 | VISITING SEA CREATURE HOMES

The fish takes the boy through magical underwater habitats.

Sharks circling ancient underwater caves

Octopus inside glowing coral homes

Jellyfish forests glowing softly

Seahorses floating through colorful reefs

Giant whale family passing majestically nearby

🎥 Camera: wide fantasy shots + emotional close-ups of boy’s reactions

---

⏱️ 0:09 – 0:12 | THE GREAT JUMP

The mystical fish suddenly swims upward at high speed.

Water currents spiral dramatically around them

Fish bursts out of the ocean into the sky

Massive cinematic leap above glowing sunset ocean

Boy laughs loudly with excitement, holding tightly while petting the fish’s back lovingly

🎥 Camera: slow-motion 360° aerial shot + sparkling water trails

---

⏱️ 0:12 – 0:15 | EMOTIONAL ENDING

The fish dives beautifully back into the ocean.

Huge splash with glowing water particles

Boy smiling happily, gently stroking the fish’s back

The fish looks peaceful and connected to him

Ocean glows softly as they disappear into deep blue water together

🎥 Camera: cinematic pull-back wide shot → magical fantasy fade out

---

🎭 VISUAL STYLE

Hollywood fantasy adventure realism

Magical glowing ocean world

Emotional and heartwarming atmosphere

Hyper-realistic underwater creatures and environments

Soft blue-golden cinematic lighting

Pixar + Avatar-style fantasy realism

Ultra-detailed 4K cinematic quality

---

🔊 SOUND DESIGN

Emotional orchestral fantasy soundtrack

Ocean ambience, whale sounds, bubbles

Soft magical shimmering sounds

Huge cinematic splash during jump scene

Peaceful emotional ending music

Pro Tip:
The more detailed and structured your prompt (scenes, motion, lighting, effects), the more cinematic and realistic your result will be.

Create. Experiment. Elevate your visuals 🚀

Ultra-cinematic Hollywood fantasy movie opening set in a breathtaking magical ocean world. A young boy rides on the back of a giant beautiful mystical fish swimming through crystal-clear deep blue water. The fish is elegant, glowing softly with iridescent scales, long flowing fins, and majestic eyes. The atmosphere feels magical, emotional, adventurous, and visually stunning like a high-budget fantasy film opening.

The underwater world is alive with glowing corals, ancient ruins, colorful sea creatures, sun rays piercing through the water, bubbles, and cinematic ocean depth. The fish lovingly takes the boy on a journey through the ocean, showing him the homes of different sea animals.

translations.es:
---
Apertura de película de fantasía ultra-cinemática de Hollywood ambientada en un impresionante mundo oceánico mágico. Un joven monta en la espalda de un hermoso pez místico gigante que nada a través de aguas cristalinas de un azul profundo. El pez es elegante, brillando suavemente con escamas iridiscentes, aletas largas y fluidas, y ojos majestuosos. La atmósfera se siente mágica, emocional, aventurera y visualmente impresionante, como la apertura de una película de fantasía de alto presupuesto.

El mundo submarino está vivo con corales brillantes, ruinas antiguas, coloridas criaturas marinas, rayos de sol atravesando el agua, burbujas y una profundidad oceánica cinematográfica. El pez lleva amorosamente al niño en un viaje a través del océano, mostrándole los hogares de diferentes animales marinos.

El niño se siente asombrado, en paz y profundamente conectado con el pez mágico, acariciando suavemente su espalda mientras sonríe con pura alegría.
---
translations.fr:
---
Ouverture ultra-cinématographique d'un film fantastique hollywoodien se déroulant dans un monde océanique magique à couper le souffle. Un jeune garçon chevauche le dos d'un magnifique poisson mystique géant nageant à travers une eau d'un bleu profond et cristallin. Le poisson est élégant, brillant doucement avec des écailles irisées, de longues nageoires fluides et des yeux majestueux. L'atmosphère est magique, émotive, aventureuse et visuellement époustouflante, comme l'ouverture d'un film fantastique à gros budget.

Le monde sous-marin est vivant avec des coraux lumineux, des ruines anciennes, des créatures marines colorées, des rayons de soleil perçant l'eau, des bulles et une profondeur océanique cinématographique. Le poisson emmène affectueusement le garçon dans un voyage à travers l'océan, lui montrant les habitats de différents animaux marins.

Le garçon se sent émerveillé, paisible et profondément connecté au poisson magique, caressant doucement son dos tout en souriant de joie pure.
translations.ja:
---
息をのむような魔法の海の世界を舞台にした、超シネマティックなハリウッドファンタジー映画のオープニング。若い少年が巨大で美しい神秘的な魚の背に乗り、透き通った深い青の水を泳いでいる。魚は優雅で、虹色に輝く鱗を持ち、長く流れるヒレと威厳ある目で柔らかく光っている。雰囲気は魔法のようで、感情的で冒険心に満ち、高予算のファンタジー映画のオープニングのように視覚的に驚異的である。

水中の世界は、輝くサンゴ、古代の遺跡、色とりどりの海の生物、太陽の光が水を突き抜ける様子、泡、そしてシネマティックな海の深さで生き生きとしている。魚は少年を愛情を込めて海の旅に連れて行き、さまざまな海の生き物の住処を見せてくれる。

少年は驚き、平和を感じ、魔法の魚と深くつながりを感じながら、その背を優しく撫で、純粋な喜びで微笑んでいる。
translations.ko:
---
초대형 할리우드 판타지 영화의 오프닝 장면이 숨막히게 아름다운 마법의 바다 세계에서 펼쳐집니다. 어린 소년이 거대한 아름다운 신비로운 물고기의 등에 올라타고 맑고 푸른 바다를 헤엄칩니다. 그 물고기는 우아하고, 무지갯빛 비늘로 부드럽게 빛나며, 길게 흐르는 지느러미와 장엄한 눈을 가지고 있습니다. 분위기는 마법적이고, 감정적이며, 모험적이고, 고예산 판타지 영화의 오프닝처럼 시각적으로 놀랍습니다.

수중 세계는 빛나는 산호, 고대 유적, 다채로운 해양 생물, 물을 통과하는 햇살, 거품, 그리고 영화 같은 바다의 깊이로 가득 차 있습니다. 물고기는 소년을 사랑스럽게 바다 여행으로 안내하며, 다양한 해양 동물의 집을 보여줍니다.

소년은 경이로움과 평화로움을 느끼며, 마법의 물고기와 깊은 연결을 느끼고, 순수한 기쁨으로 미소 지으며 물고기의 등을 부드럽게 쓰다듬습니다.
---
translations.pt-BR:
Abertura de filme de fantasia ultra-cinematográfico de Hollywood ambientada em um deslumbrante mundo mágico oceânico. Um jovem garoto cavalga nas costas de um belo e místico peixe gigante que nada através de águas cristalinas e azul profundo. O peixe é elegante, brilhando suavemente com escamas iridescentes, longas nadadeiras fluídas e olhos majestosos. A atmosfera é mágica, emocional, aventureira e visualmente deslumbrante, como a abertura de um filme de fantasia de alto orçamento.

O mundo subaquático está vivo com corais brilhantes, ruínas antigas, criaturas marinhas coloridas, raios de sol penetrando na água, bolhas e profundidade oceânica cinematográfica. O peixe leva o garoto amorosamente em uma jornada pelo oceano, mostrando-lhe as casas de diferentes animais marinhos.

O garoto se sente maravilhado, em paz e profundamente conectado ao peixe mágico, acariciando suavemente suas costas enquanto sorri com pura alegria.
translations.zh-CN:
超电影化的好莱坞奇幻电影开场，设定在令人叹为观止的魔法海洋世界。一个年轻男孩骑在一条巨大而美丽的神秘鱼背上，游过清澈见底的深蓝色水域。鱼优雅地游动，鳞片柔和地发出五光十色的光芒，长长的鳍流动，眼神威严。氛围充满魔幻、情感、冒险和视觉震撼，宛如高预算的奇幻电影开场。

水下世界充满了发光的珊瑚、古老的遗迹、多彩的海洋生物、穿透水面的阳光、气泡和电影般的海洋深度。鱼带着男孩在海洋中旅行，向他展示不同海洋动物的家园。

男孩感到惊奇、平和，与神奇的鱼深深相连，轻轻抚摸着鱼的背，脸上洋溢着纯粹的喜悦。
